title: Camel Up
components: 5 Racing Dice & 1 Grey Die for crazy camels
setup: Assemble the track board and place the dice pyramid in the center area.
Place all 5 dice into the pyramid shaker, shake, and roll them out one by one onto the board to determine starting camel positions on spaces 1–3.
Stack camels that land on the exact same space (camels on top are considered ahead).
Roll the grey die to determine the starting backwards-facing positions of the 2 Crazy Camels (spaces 16 down to 14).
Each player takes 3 Egyptian pounds, 1 Spectator tile, and 5 finish betting cards of their chosen character color.
Organize the Leg Betting tiles into stacks (5, 3, 2 points) next to the track.
procedure: On your turn, take exactly 1 of the following 4 actions:
Action 1 - Take a Leg Betting Tile: Take the top tile for a camel color you think will be in 1st place when this leg ends.
Action 2 - Place Your Spectator Tile: Place your tile on an empty space on the track (Oasis side: +1 space / Mirage side: -1 space). Gain 1 coin whenever a camel unit lands on it.
Action 3 - Take a Pyramid Ticket: Take 1 Pyramid Ticket worth 1 coin, release 1 die from the pyramid, and move the matching camel (carrying all camels on top of it).
Action 4 - Bet on Overall Winner or Loser: Secretly place 1 of your Finish betting cards face-down onto the Overall Winner or Overall Loser deck.
endGame: Trigger: The game ends immediately when any camel crosses the finish line on space 16 (or beyond).
Step 1: Score the current final Leg tiles as normal.
Step 2: Score the Overall Winner deck in order (first correct bet earns 8 coins, second earns 5, etc.; incorrect bets lose 1 coin).
Step 3: Score the Overall Loser deck in the same manner.
Step 4: Count total Egyptian Pound coins in hand.
⚖️ Tie-Breaker: Most remaining Leg Betting tiles among tied players; if still tied, shared victory.
notes: Piggyback Rule: Camels carry all camels stacked above them when they move. Camels below stay behind.
Crazy Camels: Black and white camels run counter-clockwise. If a racing camel lands on a crazy camel, it is carried backward!
Leg End: A leg ends the moment the 5th die is rolled from the pyramid. Settle all leg tile payouts and reset the pyramid.
